title: Recall names and traits of native deciduous trees

cards.front: Which tree species in our selected learning group matches these traits? Usually oval leaves with a slightly wavy margin; smooth grey bark and long pointed buds.
cards.back: European beech. Usually oval leaves with a slightly wavy margin; smooth grey bark and long pointed buds.

cards.front: Which tree species in our selected learning group matches these traits? Lobed leaves with a very short leaf stalk; acorns. This combination distinguishes pedunculate oak within the selected set of four.
cards.back: Pedunculate oak. Lobed leaves with a very short leaf stalk; acorns. This combination distinguishes pedunculate oak within the selected set of four.

cards.front: Which tree species in our selected learning group matches these traits? Triangular to diamond-shaped leaves with a double-toothed margin; white peeling bark, dark and fissured at the base of older trees.
cards.back: Silver birch. Triangular to diamond-shaped leaves with a double-toothed margin; white peeling bark, dark and fissured at the base of older trees.

cards.front: Which tree species in our selected learning group matches these traits? Opposite, usually five-lobed leaves with coarsely toothed lobes; two-winged fruits.
cards.back: Sycamore maple. Opposite, usually five-lobed leaves with coarsely toothed lobes; two-winged fruits.
